title: One Partner. One Work-Ready Solution.
body_markdown:
Utilimaster’s Refrigerated Cargo Van provides a turnkey solution that brings insulation, refrigeration, interior accessories, decals, and other vehicle enhancements together through one upfit partner. This simplifies the process for end users and fleet managers by bringing multiple upfit needs together through a single partner.


The opportunity extends well beyond traditional refrigerated delivery. Utilimaster’s solutions can support many industries, including:


- Catering and food[service](https://www.aebi-schmidt.com/en/products-solutions/maintenance-service/)
- Grocery and last-mile delivery
- Medical and pharmaceutical couriers
- Floral delivery
- Dairy distribution
- Vending services


Approved ship-thru programs offer another way Utilimaster is simplifying the path to a completed refrigerated vehicle. This allows fleet managers to order completed vehicles through established OEM channels. With strategically located facilities in Kansas City and Landisville (USA), Utilimaster is positioned to efficiently support customers across key regions.


The interior provides ample cargo space while maintaining the temperature needed for refrigerated products.


Nick Troiola, Director of Sales at Utilimaster states, “We've listened closely to our customers, and they need more than a refrigerated vehicle. They need confidence that their products will arrive as intended. As regulations and industry standards continue to raise the bar for temperature-controlled freight, we're committed to delivering solutions that protect the product and more importantly, the consumer.”


With more than 10 years of experience building refrigerated van solutions, Utilimaster is ready to bring that expertise to more industries. Our complete-vehicle approach helps businesses spend less time coordinating the upfit process and more time putting their vehicles to work.


**If you need temperature control, you need Utilimaster.**
